verdict.rationale: Claude is itself an AI assistant/agent, so it sits in the MCP client role. All MCP evidence (custom connectors via remote MCP, local MCP servers on Claude Desktop, and the probe pointing to the custom-connectors article) describes Claude connecting to MCP servers, which is client-side and belongs to the MCP-client story. Nothing shows Claude itself running as an MCP server, such as a serve subcommand or a first-party hosted endpoint, so this server axis does not apply.
